craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of the sealed proof — utsāha as each consequence collapses and the maker stands. ABANDON: unjust-unfit; Maker-proved-plain-as-day (rhyme kept — L3s, traces locked). Rejected: (a) day→light → killed: rhyme is L3s + day is plain. Read aloud: DROP the-NA-ture-VIEW … PROVED and-PLAIN as-DAY.

lines: Drop the nature-view — unjust, unfit to stay;
bodies bespeak a knowing Maker, proved and plain as day.

reads_against.argmap: Abandoned — what stands? → The siddhānta: bodies bespeak a knowing maker.
c1_essence: The svabhāva-view's consequences pressed: desired-by-all yet body-changes by nature; occurrence without union; needlessness fitting neither spirit nor mind; no reunion yet rebirth; mokṣa collapsed into nature; compassion-acts forcing passion-exhaustion doctrine (vv46-51).
The siddhānta sealed: nature-view abandoned as unjust, bodies famously sentient-maker-prior, arrangement-difference the flawless proof, the hetu aimed at Parameśvara unshaken (vv52-54).
